title: Manage vendor renewals and orderly offboarding
summary: Before a vendor contract renews, changes scope or ends. An approved renew, replace or exit decision with reconciled access, data, billing and residual obligations.
outcomes: An approved renew, replace or exit decision with reconciled access, data, billing and residual obligations.
guidance: Start with the applicability facts and evidence listed in the first step. Resolve missing facts before authorizing the affected work. Completion requires the documented outcome, including tracked exceptions; starting an application or recording a task is not evidence of completion.
when: Before a vendor contract renews, changes scope or ends.

parts.title: Compile the contract and operating evidence
parts.guidance: Collect the agreement, notice terms, usage, spending, support history, data access and business dependencies. Verify the vendor owner and identify commitments extending beyond the apparent subscription end date.

execution.rationale: Prepare or reconcile the specified private evidence and documents; external changes and decisions use their own approved steps.

parts.title: Assess renewal, replacement and exit alternatives
parts.guidance: The owner reviews value, risk, security and migration effort with relevant teams. Counsel confirms termination or data-handling constraints and approves any negotiation or notice strategy.

execution.rationale: The accountable person performs the decision, expert assessment or personal interaction described in this step. Supporting preparation does not authorize that act.

approval.scope: Assess renewal, replacement and exit alternatives

parts.title: Prepare the transition and data plan
parts.guidance: List exports, replacement systems, integrations, credentials, user communication and financial changes. Test representative data portability before authorizing cancellation of a critical service.

execution.rationale: Prepare or reconcile the specified private evidence and documents; external changes and decisions use their own approved steps.

parts.title: Authorize the commercial decision and implementation
parts.guidance: The designated approvers finalize renewal terms or the permitted exit action. Authorized operators execute notices and account changes within scope while preserving required service continuity.

execution.rationale: The accountable person performs the decision, expert assessment or personal interaction described in this step. Supporting preparation does not authorize that act.

approval.scope: Authorize the commercial decision and implementation

parts.title: Reconcile completion and retained obligations
parts.guidance: Verify data receipt or deletion, revoked access, final invoices and active replacement services. Keep remaining support, retention or audit obligations assigned and retain evidence of the approved outcome.

execution.rationale: Prepare or reconcile the specified private evidence and documents; external changes and decisions use their own approved steps.

verify.how: An approved renew, replace or exit decision with reconciled access, data, billing and residual obligations.

notes.text: This is an operational coordination guide. Confirm the applicable company facts, contracts and jurisdictions before acting. The cited authorities describe their named jurisdictions or frameworks; their rules are not asserted for other countries. External actions require approval for the specific action.
